question_text: A group of farmers in Nueva Ecija are demanding that the government distribute to them the unused agricultural land of a large private estate. Under Article XIII of the 1987 Constitution, which of the following best describes the state's duty?

options.text: The state has no duty to distribute private lands because the Constitution protects private property rights.
The state must distribute the land to the farmers only if the landowner voluntarily agrees to sell.
The state shall, by law, undertake an agrarian reform program that includes the distribution of lands to farmers, subject to payment of just compensation to the landowner.
The state may distribute the land but only if the farmers pay the full market value to the government.
